activities.name: Arrive Fukuoka Airport (~5 PM)
activities.description: Land at FUK, clear customs, grab IC card, subway to Hakata — 5 stops, 11 minutes.
notes: Subway: Kuko Line from FUK → Hakata Station — ¥260, runs every 5–8 min
Get a Suica or ICOCA IC card at the airport — works on all trains, buses, and convenience stores for the whole trip
Hilton Fukuoka Sea Hawk is ~15 min taxi from Hakata Station or short subway hop

activities.name: Tenjin Underground City (optional)
activities.description: Japan's largest underground shopping arcade, 20 min from the airport by subway. Good for stretching legs and grabbing anything you forgot — or just absorbing that you are in Japan.
notes: Most stores open until 8–9 PM
Subway: Kuko Line → Tenjin Station, ¥300 from airport
Skip without guilt if the flight wrecked you — Day 3 Okagaki is the priority

activities.name: First ramen in Japan
activities.description: The real deal, straight off the plane. Ichiran Ramen HQ is the top pick — original location with the iconic solo booth system and fully customizable tonkotsu broth. Canal City Ramen Stadium is the backup if Ichiran has a wait, with 8 regional ramen styles on the 5th floor.
notes: Ichiran Ramen HQ: near Canal City Hakata — customize spice level (try 3+), order kaedama for extra noodles
Canal City Ramen Stadium: 5th floor, 8 regional shops — try miso or shoyu to contrast tonkotsu
Ippudo or Shin Shin are simpler fallbacks closer to Hakata Station
Keep dinner easy and get to bed — jet lag hits hard on Night 1

activities.name: JR train to Okagaki (Ebitsu Station)
activities.description: Hop on the JR Kagoshima Main Line from Hakata Station north to Ebitsu Station — the gateway to the Okagaki coast and Sanri Matsubara.
notes: ~45–50 min from Hakata Station, trains run frequently
Fare: ~¥770 each way; IC card (Suica/ICOCA) works
Tourist Station Hokutochisei is a short ride from the station — the hub for bike rental and BBQ

activities.name: Coastal Cycling — Sanri Matsubara
activities.description: Rent bikes at Tourist Station Hokutochisei and cruise the 12 km dedicated cycling path through the Sanri Matsubara pine forest along the Hibiki Sea coast. E-bikes, sports bikes, and tandems available. Flat, shaded, and scenic with breakwater art photo spots along the route.
notes: Bike rental hub: Tourist Station Hokutochisei — no reservation needed
Sports bike: ¥800 (3 hr) / ¥1,200 (all day)
Regular bike: ¥300 (3 hr) / ¥500 (all day)
Hours: 9:00–17:00 (last rental 16:00), closed Wednesdays
Path stretches 12 km toward Munakata City — flat, coastal, shaded by 300-year-old pines
Watch for 'breakwater art' Instagram spots along the route

activities.name: Mt. Yukawa Hike
activities.description: 470m peak on the Okagaki–Munakata border. The summit delivers a panoramic sweep of the entire Sanri Matsubara coastline — blue Hibiki Sea, white sand, and the pine forest you just cycled through. Narita-san Fudoji temple sits partway up at ~200m elevation with its own views. En route: 'Ghost Slope' (ゆうれい坂), the famous optical illusion where cans appear to roll uphill.
notes: ~2–3 hours round trip at an easy-moderate pace
Stop at Ghost Slope on the road up — roll an empty can and watch it 'climb'
Narita-san Fudoji temple at mid-elevation is a worthwhile break
Summit view covers the full 12 km coastline you rode earlier
Trail is forested and shaded — bring water, low 80s°F + humidity

activities.name: SUP & Surfing — RUN'A WAVE
activities.description: Surf school on the Hibiki Sea at Hamatsu Coast. May brings calm conditions — ideal for SUP (stand-up paddleboard) or a first surf lesson. Welcoming to beginners and all fitness levels.
notes: Website: runawave.com
Address: Uchiura, Okagaki-machi, Onga-gun, Fukuoka
Call ahead to book a session — pricing not published online, confirm by phone
May = calm shoulder-season swell, best window for beginner SUP and surf
Hamatsu Beach is a Ministry of Environment Top 100 Swimming Beach — great spot to cool off after the hike

location.name: RUN'A WAVE Surf School — Hamatsu Coast

activities.name: Ichiran Ramen HQ (city alternative)
activities.description: If skipping or cutting the Okagaki day short, Ichiran's original location is right near Canal City Hakata — the iconic solo-booth tonkotsu experience worth doing at least once.
notes: Customize: richness level, spice, garlic, scallion, chashu, noodle firmness
Order kaedama (extra noodles) when you get low
Can be combined with Canal City Ramen Stadium in the same afternoon

activities.name: Canal City Hakata — Ramen Stadium (city alternative)
activities.description: 8 regional ramen shops on the 5th floor of Canal City — good if you want to compare styles in one stop. The mall itself is worth wandering between bowls.
notes: Try a different style than Ichiran — miso, shoyu, or spicy tantanmen
Mini portions available at some stalls for sampling multiple shops
City alternative if weather cancels the Okagaki day trip

activities.name: Return to Fukuoka by JR
activities.description: Head back to Hakata on the JR Kagoshima Main Line in time for the evening yatai stalls.
notes: ~45–50 min back to Hakata Station, last train is late evening
Optional: stay for dinner in Okagaki instead — Sushi Yatai (fresh hakatamae sushi), Seaside Inn Hatsushiro (live squid + fugu), or Chanpon no Shoro (local soul food)

activities.name: Yatai street food stalls
activities.description: Riverside food stalls in Nakasu or Tenjin area — the classic Fukuoka send-off after a big active day.
